verdict.rationale: Apple docs mention Spotlight as a keyboard-driven launcher for search/actions (macos-docs-15), but there is no evidence of comprehensive native hotkey-based window management or full system control via keyboard alone. Community hands-on reports directly contradict smooth keyboard/hotkey window operation, describing painful, mouse-precision-dependent resizing/moving and the need for third-party tools like Moom to get 'life changing' keyboard-friendly window control (macos-comm-5, macos-comm-7, macos-comm-8, macos-comm-9). Missing for 10: documentation of native customizable hotkeys for window snapping/resizing, evidence of full app-launching and system-wide action via keyboard without third-party utilities, and confirmation that power users can avoid the mouse entirely.
